decision: The Super Licence of the driver of Car 20 is suspended for the next Competition of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship. Following this suspension, 12 penalty points will be removed.
fact: The driver of Car 20 has accrued 12 penalty points in the past 12-month period of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship.
offence: Breach of Article 4.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: The Super Licence of the driver of Car 20 is suspended for the next Competition of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship. Following this suspension, 12 penalty points will be removed.
reason: In accordance with Article 4.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, as the Driver of Car 20 has accrued 12 penalty points (see Document 57), the Super Licence of the driver of Car 20 must be suspended for the next Competition.
